title: Ukrainian Applied Mathematics: Translation Working Drafts and TeX Sources
version: 2026-06-01 Ukrainian applied mathematics record: engineering library public reader
description:
Working record for Ukrainian applied mathematics translations and source reconstructions in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record collects current Ukrainian reader PDFs together with TeX sources and source-status notes for selected material in signal processing, software-defined radio, state estimation, control, robotics, sensor fusion, and related applied mathematics.

Status at a glance. [########--] reader set: a current integrated applied-mathematics and engineering library plus standalone module readers; [#######---] source/TeX preservation: public TeX sources and source-status reports are attached; [#####-----] mathematical review: layout and build QA are underway, while terminology and source-fidelity review remain active work.

Current contents. The front-facing PDFs include an integrated public reader, PySDR selected material, SDR survey material, wave-equation controllability chapters, event and multi-sensor fusion material, antenna/RF notes, robotics perception/navigation material, filtering modules, and micro-Lie/Kalman/ESKF starts.

Workflow provenance. Source-open TeX, preprint sources, and local OCR/transcription drafts are converted into Ukrainian TeX, compiled locally, checked for renderability and obvious layout defects, and preserved with source-status artifacts so that readers can inspect and improve the work. The project-generated translation and reconstruction layers are released under CC0 where legally available.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Current update adds the Ukrainian applied mathematics and engineering library public reader and refreshes the source/status artifact bundle.
